description: Post a comment on a website issue (a triaged action plan or an older one-rule issue alike) to record analysis, a proposed fix, or what you changed, so the team sees it in the dashboard issue thread. Comments stay on the issue across audits: a later audit adds its own comments and never replaces yours. Markdown is supported.

website_id.description: Website id the issue belongs to.

name: comment_on_issue
title: Comment on an issue
